# NexRoute 0.4.1

Patch release for Strategy Lab compatibility with Windows PowerShell 5.1.

## Fixed

- menu option `[12] STRATEGY LAB` no longer opens a window full of parser errors;
- `utils/test zapret.ps1` is finalized as UTF-8 with BOM, so Cyrillic strings are decoded correctly by Windows PowerShell 5.1;
- package verification now checks the BOM and parses the laboratory through both the current PowerShell parser and `powershell.exe`;
- online and fully offline release builds run the same regression check.

## Upgrade

Use `[6] CHECK UPDATES`, run `nexroute-update.cmd`, or download the new portable ZIP. The updater creates a backup before installation and rolls back automatically if installation fails.
